name: dobot_benchmark_data
description: A dataset and benchmark for evaluating manipulation and perception capabilities of the Dobot robotic arm across representative tasks (e.g., object recognition, pose estimation, and control). It provides recorded sensor streams and annotations designed to measure end-to-end task performance and robustness under realistic variations. The benchmark is intended to support development and comparison of vision and control algorithms for small-scale robotic manipulation.
reputation: A niche, task-specific benchmark used primarily within robotics and manipulation research with limited broad community adoption.
